name: Ora
description_en:
Ora is a project and task-management service whose public site now directs attention to its closure and data export. Its dated announcement says the team joined ClickUp and stopped accepting new subscriptions after June 7 following the May 2025 announcement. This record therefore focuses on understanding existing work and preparing an evidence-checked exit, rather than recommending a new subscription.

Legacy documentation describes projects with card lists, multiple views, estimates, time entries and integrations. Those pages help identify what needs preserving; their continued availability does not demonstrate that an account or connector still works. No account was accessed and no export or migration was executed for this profile.
description_zh:
Ora 是项目与任务管理服务，现官网重点提示关闭与数据导出。其带日期公告说明团队加入 ClickUp，并在 2025 年 5 月公告之后的 6 月 7 日起停止接受新订阅。因此，本档案侧重理解既有工作及核对退出准备，不建议新购订阅。

旧文档介绍了卡片列表、多种视图、估算、工时条目和集成。这些资料可以帮助确认需要保留什么；页面仍可访问，并不能证明账户或连接器仍正常运行。本次未访问账户，也未执行导出或迁移。

sections.title_en: Read the closure notice before the signup buttons
sections.title_zh: 先读关闭提示，再看注册按钮
sections.en:
The homepage says the service is closing and asks users to export. The May 27, 2025 announcement set out remaining access for an annual billing cycle or six months of a monthly subscription, with no new subscriptions after June 7. These statements do not establish a single final date for every account.

Existing users should confirm their remaining access and export assistance with Ora support. A reachable pricing page, signup button or API reference does not override the notice. This catalog has not verified current sign-in availability or a recovery window.
sections.zh:
首页提示服务将关闭并要求导出。2025 年 5 月 27 日公告说明，年付用户按剩余计费周期、月付用户按六个月继续访问，6 月 7 日后不再接受新订阅。这些说明不能确立所有账户统一的最终关闭日期。

既有用户应向 Ora 支持确认剩余访问和导出协助。定价页、注册按钮或 API 资料仍可访问，不能推翻该提示。本目录没有核实当前登录可用性或恢复窗口。

sections.title_en: Inventory the project’s data, not only its columns
sections.title_zh: 盘点项目数据，而不只是看板列
sections.en:
Ora’s documented model includes lists of cards, table and Kanban views, descriptions, attachments, comments, checklists, assignees and due dates. Time can be recorded with timers or manual entries and reviewed in reports. Agenda draws together assigned tasks, with undated tasks in its Inbox.

For an existing client project, inventory open and closed cards, discussions, files, time records and report periods before choosing a destination. Use one representative deliverable with several of those elements as a migration sample. This preserves the meaning of the work rather than assuming that a matching card count is enough.
sections.zh:
Ora 文档模型包括卡片列表、表格和看板视图，以及描述、附件、评论、清单、负责人和截止日期。工时可通过计时器或手动记录，并在报告中查看；Agenda 汇集已分派任务，未定日期的任务进入其 Inbox。

对于既有客户项目，应先盘点未完成及已完成卡片、讨论、文件、工时记录和报告周期，再选择目标系统。建议用包含多种元素的代表性交付项作为迁移样例，保留工作的实际含义，不能只以卡片数量相同判断成功。

sections.title_en: Match the export route to the needed format
sections.title_zh: 按所需格式选择导出路径
sections.en:
The project export guide puts CSV, Markdown and Text in the project’s three-dot menu. JSON uses Project Settings and its Export section. The guide identifies formats and controls but does not document that every attachment, comment, permission and history event survives in each format.

A suggested check is to export the same representative project in a readable format and JSON, retain the originals, and compare one card’s dates, people, custom context and file references. Then check an import into the intended destination. A successful download is not proof of a complete archive or a faithful restore. No files were downloaded here.
sections.zh:
项目导出指南把 CSV、Markdown 和 Text 放在项目三点菜单中，JSON 则通过 Project Settings 的 Export 区域导出。指南确立了格式和入口，但没有证明每种格式都完整保留附件、评论、权限及历史事件。

建议把同一代表性项目导出为可读格式及 JSON，保留原文件，并对比一张卡片的日期、人员、自定义背景和文件引用，再检查目标系统中的导入结果。下载成功不等于完整归档或忠实恢复。本次没有下载任何账户文件。

sections.title_en: Separate personal, organization and project scope
sections.title_zh: 区分个人、组织与项目范围
sections.en:
Account Settings distinguishes organization and personal sections. Personal Preferences offers account-data export; organization settings cover its membership and rights. Billing and invoice controls are documented for the browser, with personal billing separate from organization billing. Project settings separately contain visibility, permissions and add-on switches.

Before an exit, identify the appropriate organization and project owner and check the data scope of each export route. A personal export should not be assumed to preserve every organization project or its financial records. The project guide defaults visibility to private, so also verify what external participants can see in the destination.
sections.zh:
Account Settings 区分组织和个人区域。个人 Preferences 提供账户数据导出，组织设置管理成员与权限；账单和发票入口列为浏览器功能，个人账单与组织账单分开。项目设置则另含可见性、权限和功能附加项开关。

退出前应确定相应组织及项目负责人，检验每条导出路径的数据范围。不能假设个人导出包含组织所有项目或财务记录。项目指南默认私有可见性，因此还应验证目标系统中外部参与者能够看到什么。

sections.title_en: An empty commit stream has documented causes
sections.title_zh: 提交列表为空有具体排查依据
sections.en:
Legacy Git documentation says Ora links commits using recognized account emails, including additional aliases. It also says sidebar live updates cover new commits after the repository is linked; older commits can be searched from a task. Commit syntax can reference a task, close it or add time.

When inventorying an existing integration, check aliases and the link time before interpreting an empty sidebar as missing source history. Preserve the repository’s own history as the source record and inspect a linked task/time sample. No account email, webhook, repository or credential was changed, and current connector operation remains unverified.
sections.zh:
旧 Git 文档说明，Ora 通过已识别的账户邮箱关联提交，可添加额外别名；侧栏实时更新覆盖连接仓库之后的新提交，旧提交可从任务中搜索。提交语法可引用任务、关闭任务或添加工时。

盘点既有集成时，应先检查邮箱别名和连接时间，再判断空侧栏是否意味着来源历史缺失。建议保留仓库自身历史作为原始记录，并抽查一条关联任务及工时。本次没有修改账户邮箱、webhook、仓库或凭据，当前连接器运行仍未核实。

sections.title_en: Treat surviving prices as legacy information
sections.title_zh: 把仍可见的价格当作旧页面信息
sections.en:
The reachable page still advertises Basic for ten users, Professional at USD5.99/user/month annually or USD10 monthly, and Enterprise at USD27.99 annually or USD30 monthly. It lists a thirty-day trial with card details. These are page contents, not an available new offer in light of the closure notice; no ongoing-free eligibility or normalized purchase price is assigned.

The pricing FAQ says applicable VAT is included, while the terms say listed prices exclude taxes. Existing users need account-specific billing clarification. The terms retain users’ content rights but restrict modifying and redistributing the service software. They do not grant a self-hosting license that would keep Ora running independently.
sections.zh:
仍可访问的页面宣传十人 Basic、Professional 年付每用户每月 5.99 美元／月付 10 美元，以及 Enterprise 年付 27.99 美元／月付 30 美元，并列出需要银行卡信息的三十天试用。这是页面内容；结合关闭提示，不能当作可新购方案。本文不赋予持续免费资格，也不提供归一化购买价格。

定价 FAQ 称适用 VAT 已含，条款则称标价不含税，现有用户需要确认账户具体账务。条款保留用户内容权利，但限制修改和再分发服务软件，并未授予可独立持续运行 Ora 的自托管许可。

sections.title_en: Verify the destination before retiring the source
sections.title_zh: 停用来源前验证目标系统
sections.en:
A practical exit review should compare the representative card, its linked files and comments, one time-report period, access for an internal member and an external participant, and any recurring or automated behavior. Record missing mappings explicitly instead of treating every exported field as an equivalent destination feature.

The official announcement offers contact for export and transition assistance, but it is not a documented automatic migration or a guarantee of feature parity with ClickUp. This record therefore leaves alternative relationships unreviewed. Choose a destination using its current documentation and verify the imported result before relying on it.
sections.zh:
实际退出核对应比较代表性卡片及文件／评论、一个工时报表周期、内部成员与外部参与者访问，以及循环或自动化行为。缺失映射应明确记录，不能把每个导出字段当作目标系统中的等价功能。

官方公告提供导出与过渡协助联系方式，但它不等于已记录的自动迁移，也不保证与 ClickUp 功能完全一致。因此本档案的替代关系仍未审核。应依据目标系统当前文档选择，并验证导入结果后再依赖它。
